desktop.title: Access Desktop from your phone
desktop.description: Connect Desktop, then create a phone device invite in Desktop. Start with deployment checks and view connection status here.

tileTip.rtt: Computed from RTT histogram buckets — averaging p95 values is arithmetically wrong.
tileTip.loss: Measured carrier loss, not a retransmit rate.
tileTip.directRatio: Direct vs relayed sessions. This is the number that predicts your bandwidth bill.
